scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-depth theorem is proved by induction, not inferred from finite tests. All listed tests can be replayed using verify.py. Original publication is acknowledged; first public date is the July 2026 journal version, not the later preprint upload.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the exact FDE-S5 indexed-operator semantics and its specified propositional language, without a primitive box/diamond or independently named nonclassical truth constants. No claim about all twenty-four operator interdefinabilities or other frame semantics.
title: Classical-fragment obstruction separates all Belnapian truth-status modalities from inconsistency and indeterminacy
